title: V01-C05 Values and Data Types Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: At least ten values classified by domain meaning, runtime type, representation, valid operations, absence policy, and justified exceptions.
A conversion matrix that identifies precision or meaning loss for normal, boundary, invalid, and ambiguous inputs and defines accept, reject, or preserve-raw decisions.

accessibility_requirements: Every diagram has an ordered text alternative.
Tables use descriptive headers and do not rely on color.
Animations have static and reduced-motion alternatives.
Turkish technical terms include English at first meaningful use.
Code has Turkish comments and explicit expected output.
Learner instructions have measurable deliverables and time boxes.
known_risks: Learners may classify digit-shaped identifiers as numbers.
JavaScript-specific behavior may be overgeneralized to all languages.
Explicit conversion may be mistaken for safe conversion.
NaN, null, undefined, zero, false, and empty text may be conflated.
Floating-point and Unicode detail may overload a beginner.
AI may infer domain types without validated requirements.
Student pilot is deferred by Repository Owner until later production.
